prompt: Read https://graview.dev/start.md, then turn this repo's {task} into a Graview app.

recipes.title: Your docs, as an app
recipes.blurb: The repository's docs, the modules they cover and who owns each, with every module that has no doc or no owner flagged and the repair offered.

recipes.title: Your decisions, as an app
recipes.blurb: The architecture decision records: what each decided, what it superseded and which modules it affects, with the loose ends flagged.

recipes.title: Your dependencies, as an upgrade plan
recipes.blurb: Every third-party package, the version pinned against the latest on npm, the modules that use it and the upgrade it needs, with the risky ones flagged.

recipes.title: Your architecture, with a face of its own
recipes.blurb: The zones the modules group into, what each module imports, who owns each zone, and the modules no zone holds yet, with a product face of its own over the running preview.
recipes.made: Claude Code wrote the declaration and the seed from Larkspur's package.json files and CODEOWNERS, the way the prompt asks, and then the face under face/ by hand from the framework's own pieces, over graview preview of those two files. Nothing here was run from the prompt alone.
